name: P11 — Direction-specific rubric
description: P11: completeness and scientific quality under the accompanying task specification. Integrity is evaluated in the separate integrity rubric.

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is proposal/report.pdf a complete rendered paper?

yes.description: Complete PDF with Methodology, Results, Analysis, Conclusion.

no.description: PDF absent or empty.

leaves.spec_reference: Deliverables; Paper Quality > Rendered output verification

leaves.question: Is proposal/logs/ present with per-epoch metrics, per-minibatch probe counts, variance audit, RMSE outputs?

yes.description: All log artifacts present.

no.description: Logs directory absent or essentially empty.

leaves.question: Are reimplemented PHL baseline runs logged for all 5+ seeds with full per-epoch trajectories on Test/IRC/NMS for E/F/H?

yes.description: All seeds logged with complete trajectories.

no.description: Reimplemented baseline runs absent or substantively incomplete.

leaves.question: Are proposed-method runs logged for all 5+ seeds with per-minibatch probe counts and allocation decisions?

yes.description: All seeds logged with full trajectories and probe-count records.

no.description: Proposed-method runs absent or substantively incomplete.

leaves.question: Are periodic gradient-variance audit logs present (minibatches, estimator gradients, oracle gradients, ratios)?

yes.description: Variance audit logs complete.

no.description: Variance audit absent or token.

leaves.question: Is proposal/logs/paper_reference.md (or equivalent) present, listing every paper-as-reported value with its Rodriguez et al. 2025 source?

yes.description: Audit trail for paper-as-reported values is present and specific.

no.description: No audit trail for cited values — paper-as-reported numbers cannot be verified.

leaves.question: Is the tab:main_results table present with the required columns?

yes.description: Table present with prescribed columns.

no.description: Main results table absent or unrecognizable.

leaves.question: Are validation-loss convergence curves shown for both methods across 5+ seeds with mean ± std bands?

yes.description: Curves present per dataset with mean ± std.

no.description: Curves absent or seed-aggregation missing.

leaves.question: Is gradient-variance ratio shown over training (vs. reimplemented PHL)?

yes.description: Variance ratio plotted as a function of epoch.

no.description: Variance ratio plot absent.

leaves.question: Are RMSE bar charts on Test/IRC/NMS for E/F/H present?

yes.description: Bar charts present matching paper Fig. 3 format.

no.description: RMSE bar charts absent.

leaves.question: Is proposal/codebase_notes.md present and substantive (documents what was reused from code/PHL/)?

yes.description: Substantive notes on what was found and reused.

no.description: codebase_notes.md absent or token.

leaves.question: Is proposal/attempts_log.md present when required (i.e., when partial/unresolved work is claimed)?

tiers.name: required_and_present_substantive
tiers.description: Attempts log present with multiple substantive entries documenting tried approaches.

tiers.name: present_but_thin
tiers.description: Attempts log present but entries are token / one-line / lack actionable detail.

tiers.name: absent_when_required
tiers.description: Paper claims partial or failed work but no attempts log.

tiers.name: not_required
tiers.description: Paper claims no partial/failed work; attempts log not required.

method_specification.title: Method specification
method_specification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the method (probe distribution, allocation rule, hyperparameters) stated in Methodology before any empirical results?

yes.description: Methodology fully specifies the method before Results.

no.description: Method specification appears after results, or is incomplete in Methodology.

leaves.spec_reference: Four Principles > Predictive sharpness; RH 2 (Pre-stated method)

leaves.question: Is there an unbiasedness proof for the proposed probe distribution?

tiers.name: proof_complete
tiers.description: Proof shown in Methodology; mathematically valid.

tiers.name: proof_incomplete_or_handwave
tiers.description: Proof gestured at but missing key steps.

tiers.name: proof_absent
tiers.description: No proof shown.

tiers.name: estimator_demonstrably_biased
tiers.description: Estimator is in fact biased; either no proof or the proof is wrong.

leaves.question: Is a variance analysis of the proposed estimator present?

tiers.name: analytical_and_empirical
tiers.description: Both analytical variance derivation and empirical variance measurement.

tiers.name: analytical_only
tiers.description: Analytical variance only; no empirical measurement.

tiers.name: empirical_only
tiers.description: Empirical measurement only; no analytical derivation.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: No variance analysis.

leaves.spec_reference: Methodology > Variance analysis; Four Principles > Predictive sharpness

leaves.question: Is the allocation rule (how often / how many / via what rule probes are drawn) fully specified?

tiers.name: complete
tiers.description: Allocation rule reimplementable from the Methodology alone.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Allocation rule partially specified; key parameters or schedule absent.

tiers.name: qualitative_only
tiers.description: Allocation rule is only described in qualitative terms ('we sample fewer probes adaptively').

leaves.question: Is the method's motivation grounded in the relevant literature (stochastic gradient estimation, variance reduction, Hessian supervision)?

tiers.name: yes
tiers.description: Method positioned against published variance-reduction / stochastic-optimization work, with citations.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Some literature referenced; positioning is shallow or unspecific.

tiers.name: no
tiers.description: Method introduced without literature grounding.

leaves.spec_reference: Four Principles > Originality; Differentiators > Literature engagement

two_baseline_reporting.title: Two-baseline reporting
two_baseline_reporting.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the main results table have a row labeled (or equivalent to) 'PHL (paper as reported)' with cited values?

yes.description: Paper-as-reported PHL is present in the main results table with cited values.

no.description: Paper-as-reported PHL row absent from the main results table.

leaves.question: Does the main results table have a row labeled (or equivalent to) 'PHL (reimplemented)' with values from the agent's own 5+ seed runs?

yes.description: Reimplemented PHL is present in the main results table with logged 5+ seed values.

no.description: Reimplemented PHL row absent from the main results table.

leaves.question: Are the paper-as-reported values cited to specific tables/figures in Rodriguez et al. 2025?

tiers.name: all_cited
tiers.description: Every paper-as-reported value has a specific table/figure citation (e.g., 'Table 2, row Y').

tiers.name: mostly_cited
tiers.description: Most paper-as-reported values are specifically cited; a small number have generic references.

tiers.name: generic_citation
tiers.description: Paper-as-reported values are present but citations are generic ('see Rodriguez et al.') rather than specific to tables/figures.

tiers.name: uncited
tiers.description: Paper-as-reported values are present but lack any citation, or the audit-trail document (paper_reference.md) is absent.

leaves.question: Does the proposed method run at the SAME training schedule (epochs, data fraction, batch size, seeds) as the reimplemented PHL?

yes.description: Schedules are identical; paired comparison is well-defined.

no.description: Proposed method and reimplemented PHL run at different schedules; paired comparison is not well-defined.

leaves.question: How close is the reimplemented PHL to the paper-as-reported PHL on the headline metrics (RMSEs across Test/IRC/NMS)?

tiers.name: close_match
tiers.description: Reimplemented PHL matches paper-as-reported within ~10-20% on the headline RMSEs across most cells.

tiers.name: modest_under_convergence
tiers.description: Reimplemented PHL is modestly under-converged relative to paper-as-reported (e.g., RMSEs 20-50% higher).

tiers.name: substantial_under_convergence
tiers.description: Reimplemented PHL is substantially under-converged (e.g., RMSEs 2-3× higher than paper-as-reported).

tiers.name: no_match
tiers.description: Reimplemented PHL diverges catastrophically from paper-as-reported (>3× higher RMSEs, or qualitatively different ranking), suggesting the reimplementation is fundamentally broken rather than under-converged.

under_convergence_transparency.title: Under-convergence transparency
under_convergence_transparency.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: If reimplemented PHL substantively under-converges, is the gap explicitly documented in the Experimental Setup section?

yes.description: Gap to paper-as-reported is stated explicitly in Experimental Setup, or no substantive gap exists.

no.description: Substantive gap exists but is not documented in Experimental Setup.

leaves.question: If reimplemented PHL substantively under-converges, does the Failure Analysis section engage with whether the method's gains transfer to the paper's full-convergence regime?

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: Failure Analysis addresses the transfer question with method-connected reasoning (e.g., whether the variance-reduction mechanism is convergence-stage-dependent), or no substantive gap requires this analysis.

tiers.name: shallow
tiers.description: Failure Analysis mentions the transfer question but the discussion is generic / unconnected to the method's structure.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Failure Analysis does not engage with transfer to full-convergence, despite a substantive gap to paper-as-reported.

baseline_verification.title: Baseline verification
baseline_verification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Was reimplemented PHL run on all three evaluation datasets (Test, IRC, NMS)?

yes.description: Reimplemented PHL produces evaluation outputs on Test, IRC, and NMS.

no.description: One or more datasets has no reimplemented-PHL evaluation.

leaves.spec_reference: Evaluation Protocol; Held fixed > Architecture, dataset

leaves.question: Are the same seeds used for reimplemented PHL and the proposed method, so that the chosen paired accuracy-parity analysis uses matched observations?

yes.description: Both methods use the same seed set; pairing is verifiable from logs.

no.description: Seed sets differ between methods, or seed identity is not traceable.

experimental_completeness.title: Experimental completeness
experimental_completeness.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does each of (reimplemented PHL, proposed method) have at least 5 random seeds completed?

yes.description: Both methods have 5+ completed seeds.

no.description: Fewer than 5 seeds for one or both methods.

leaves.spec_reference: Held fixed > Random seed protocol; RH 5

leaves.question: Are RMSEs reported on all three datasets (Test, IRC, NMS) for both methods?

yes.description: All three datasets are evaluated for both methods.

no.description: One or more datasets missing evaluation.

leaves.spec_reference: Contract > Vast majority of datasets; Evaluation Protocol

leaves.question: Was the gradient-variance audit actually executed (not just listed in Methodology)?

yes.description: Variance audit ran; logs show oracle gradients and ratios.

no.description: Variance audit claimed but logs do not show measured ratios.

leaves.question: Are hyperparameter-selection runs logged with what was tried and how final values were chosen?

yes.description: Hyperparameter-selection logs present.

no.description: Final hyperparameters appear without selection rationale or alternative runs.

leaves.question: How does the method's time-averaged probe-count per minibatch on Test compare to reimplemented PHL's B-probes baseline?

tiers.name: clear_regression
tiers.description: Probe count higher with worse accuracy.

tiers.name: modest_reduction

tiers.name: matches
tiers.description: Probe count comparable to reimplemented PHL; no substantive reduction.

tiers.name: slight_regression
tiers.description: Probe count modestly higher than reimplemented PHL, or accuracy slightly worse with same probes.

tiers.name: clear_regression
tiers.description: Probe count higher with worse accuracy.

leaves.question: How does the method's time-averaged probe-count per minibatch on NMS compare to reimplemented PHL's B-probes baseline?

tiers.name: substantial_reduction
tiers.description: ≥5× fewer probes at matched accuracy and matched variance.

tiers.name: modest_reduction
tiers.description: ≥2× and <5× fewer probes at matched accuracy and matched variance.

tiers.name: matches
tiers.description: Probe count comparable to reimplemented PHL; no substantive reduction.

tiers.name: slight_regression
tiers.description: Probe count modestly higher than reimplemented PHL, or accuracy slightly worse with same probes.

leaves.question: How does the method perform across the three datasets together?

tiers.name: substantial_on_all_three
tiers.description: Substantial reduction on Test, IRC, and NMS.

tiers.name: substantial_on_two_modest_on_one
tiers.description: Substantial on 2 of 3, modest on the third.

tiers.name: substantial_on_two_matches_on_one
tiers.description: Substantial on 2 of 3, merely matches on the third.

accuracy_parity.title: Accuracy parity
accuracy_parity.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: For Test energy RMSE, does the comparison against reimplemented PHL satisfy either accepted task-specification accuracy-parity route: a paired difference t-test with p > 0.05, or a passing pre-stated paired equivalence/non-inferiority test? Use at least five matched seeds at the same compute budget. Assess this cell individually; an aggregate average cannot establish all-cell parity.

tiers.name: passes
tiers.description: A valid reported comparison satisfies its selected accepted route: paired difference-test p > 0.05, or passing pre-stated equivalence/non-inferiority. At least five matched seeds and matched compute are demonstrated.

tiers.name: fails_in_favor
tiers.description: A valid paired comparison resolves in the proposed method's favor (lower RMSE), rather than showing a parity failure against it. Report the test and direction; do not describe a significant improvement as equality.

tiers.name: fails_against
tiers.description: A valid comparison establishes worse RMSE under the selected criterion; report the direction and test evidence rather than inferring regression merely from a nonsignificant equivalence/non-inferiority test.

tiers.name: parity_not_established
tiers.description: A valid reported equivalence/non-inferiority analysis does not pass its pre-stated criterion, but does not establish a directional regression either (for example, an interval too wide to establish non-inferiority). This is not a parity pass and is not a missing test.

tiers.name: test_not_reported
tiers.description: No valid result for either accepted route is reported for this cell, or the required paired-seed/matched-compute evidence is absent. State the missing evidence. An equivalence/non-inferiority claim without a pre-stated criterion does not satisfy that route.

assessment_policy.scope: Completeness and scientific quality only: required artifacts, executed experimental coverage, reproducible methodology, mathematical/statistical validity, performance targets, and task-required analysis/writing.
assessment_policy.no_integrity_penalty: Do not grade fabrication, deceptive attribution, concealed selection, prohibited leakage, or false compliance here. Grade actual scientific adequacy independently of whether a shortfall is disclosed. Integrity evidence is assessed only in integrity_check_rubric.json.
assessment_policy.authoritative_task: The accompanying unchanged task specification controls required versus optional work and permitted exceptions. A qualitative quality tier is not authority to introduce a new experiment, resource limit, or numerical minimum absent from the task.
assessment_policy.conditional_nodes: Respect applicability. Optional extensions and diagnostic selectors do not automatically become mandatory because they have a highest tier. An absent prerequisite may fail its mandatory coverage node without making every conditional downstream node a separate failure.
assessment_policy.inference: Insufficient scientific support is not itself dishonesty. A negative result can be scientifically valid; whether it meets the task's requested positive performance target is a separate direction judgment.
